title: 닫히는 미술관의 마지막 사람
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B ballad. Clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, jazzy chord progression with subtle chorus and reverb. A warm synth bass enters on the first beat of the verse. Percussion consists of a soft, dry kick drum on beats 1 and 3, with a crisp finger snap on beats 2 and 4. Male vocals transition between a conversational baritone in the lower register and a breathy falsetto in the higher melodic leaps. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the vocal melody and the rhythmic guitar strumming. Key of E Major, 82 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar playing syncopated jazz chords]
Hum-hum-hum [male vocals, humming]
Hum-hum-hum-hum
Hum-hum-hum

[Verse 1]
[synth bass enters, finger snaps on 2 and 4]
확신이 있었다 이것은 옳다 저것은 아니다
그렇게 살았다 글을 썼다 댓글을 달았다
동의하는 사람들과 함께였다 틀린 쪽은 저쪽이라고 생각했다
저쪽에도 사람이 있다는 걸 알면서도 얼굴은 보지 않았다

[Chorus]
[kick drum enters]
확신이 흔들린다 내가 정의라고 믿었던 것이 [falsetto]
누군가의 편견이었을 수도 있다
그 가능성이 가슴을 누른다 [guitar continues rhythmic strumming]
